body:
## Change

F1. Check expected deck revision inside repository serialization chain immediately before dispatch. Two same-turn saves cannot consume same revision and overwrite each other. Existing rollback/error semantics retained.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN controls first persist and queues stale save. Parent reviewed commit sequencing, rollback and fixture, reran 41 repository/context tests. Worker boundaries: 52, typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Other create/delete precondition timing unchanged; separate potential audit, not claimed fixed. Production repository/reducer fixture, not native browser editor interaction. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(story): reject queued stale deck saves
